ideas.title: Plant Meteor Seeds ☄️
ideas.hook: Meteor showers hit the shared farm every few minutes. Where they land, the crater becomes rich soil that grows glowing space crops.
core_loop: Plant seeds on your plot
Watch the meteor warning and move crops out of the blast zone
Plant in fresh craters for space mutations
Harvest, sell and log new crops in the index
Buy a bigger plot and stronger seed shields
ideas.twist: A direct meteor hit destroys a crop, but a near miss gives it a rare 'cosmic' mutation, so players gamble on how close to plant.
monetization: VIP plot with a crater magnet
retention: Scheduled meteor storm event every hour
ideas.why_now: Grow / farm is rising at 1.86 (up 0.25 this week, 56 new games, 132,896 CCU) led by Throw a Seed (33,365) and Ant Evolution (22,073). Grow / farm + Disaster / weather is the top gap in the data (score 5.25), Disaster / weather sits at 2.22 (Stop The Tsunami! 9,730) and Space at 2.46.
ideas.differentiator: Farm games treat disasters as damage; here the disaster is the fertiliser and the risk is the point.

ideas.title: +1 Robot Arm 🦾
ideas.hook: Every punch bolts one more arm onto your robot. Grow from a 1-arm scrap bot into a 10,000-arm punching machine.
core_loop: Punch training bags to gain +1 arm
Arms multiply your punch power
Punch through gates to unlock new zones
Rebirth to keep a permanent arm multiplier
Fight the zone's boss robot
ideas.twist: Your robot visibly sprouts arms on screen, so huge players look like spinning metal flowers in the lobby.
ideas.why_now: +1 stat per action is rising at 1.66 (42 new games, 72,358 CCU) with +1 Venom Evolution (10,908) and +1 Boxing Battle Evolution (4,170). The '+1 ___' title formula is at 1.68 with 36 new games. +1 stat + Robots / mechs is a top gap (score 4.12) and Robots / mechs is rising at 1.81, up 0.19 (Mechs vs Kaiju's Ragdoll 7,183).
ideas.differentiator: Other +1 games grow a number; this one grows a silly, visible robot body players can show off.

ideas.title: Draw for Your Life ✏️
ideas.hook: Trapped in a dark house with a monster, all you have is a magic marker. Whatever you draw becomes real: doors, lamps, ladders, traps.
core_loop: Explore a dark room
Draw an object to block, light or escape
The game turns your drawing into a real object
Survive the monster's visit
Reach the next room and unlock new ink colours
ideas.twist: The monster copies your best drawing from the last room and uses it against you.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is rising at 1.54 (34 new games, 43,294 CCU). Paint / create + Horror is a strong gap (score 4.19). Interior maps are the top rising map style at 1.86 (PINKIE PROMISE [CH 2] 24,105, NIGHT WITH OPAH 23,636) and Story games are at 1.78, up 0.74 this week (Suzy Says! [HORROR] 18,648).
ideas.differentiator: Horror games hand you fixed tools; here every escape is something you drew yourself.

ideas.title: Run for the Chopper 🚁
ideas.hook: The base is under attack and the last helicopter leaves in 60 seconds. Sprint through trenches, dodge airstrikes and jump on before it lifts off.
core_loop: Spawn at the front line
Run through trenches while bombs drop
Grab dog tags along the way
Make the chopper or get left behind
Spend tags on speed and armour
ideas.twist: The chopper waits longer for every player already on board, so teams can hold the door for stragglers.
ideas.why_now: Escape / run is at 1.20 (32 new games, 74,501 CCU) with 13 Days to Escape [ALPHA] (15,518). Escape / run + Military / war is a gap (score 3.50) and Military / war is rising at 1.75, up 0.39 this week (Voxel Wars 19,198). Linear course maps are at 1.19.
ideas.differentiator: Military games are shooters; this is a pure panic escape with a shared timer.

ideas.title: Fish for a Jail Key 🔑
ideas.hook: You're locked in a cell with a drain in the floor. Cast a line down it and fish up junk, snacks, tools and, one day, the key.
core_loop: Cast into the cell drain
Reel in junk, food and tools
Trade catches with other inmates
Upgrade your rod and line
Catch the rare key and escape to a new prison
ideas.twist: Guards do random cell checks; anything illegal not hidden in time gets confiscated.
ideas.why_now: Fishing is rising at 1.22, up 0.45 this week (26 new games, 73,911 CCU) led by Fish For Sea Animals (16,121) and Net a Fish! (14,048). Fishing + Prison / police is a gap (score 2.88) and Prison / police is rising at 1.46, up 0.41 (13 Days to Escape [ALPHA] 15,518). The '___ for ___' formula is at 1.52, up 0.49.
ideas.differentiator: Fishing games are set on open water; this one is a cramped cell where every catch could be your way out.

ideas.title: Swing Anchors for Ships ⚓
ideas.hook: Swing a giant anchor from your dock, hook passing pirate ships and haul them into your harbour. Bigger swings reach rarer ships.
core_loop: Charge and swing the anchor
Hook a ship and reel it in
Add it to your harbour fleet
Ships earn cash over time
Buy heavier anchors to reach further
ideas.twist: Hooked ships fight back: pirate crews jump onto your dock and you must knock them off before the ship is yours.
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch is the top rising mechanic at 1.96 (60 new games, 264,366 CCU) with Throw a Seed (33,365) and Fish for Secret Animals! (15,192). Collect / index + Hit / swing is a live pair (8 new games, 76,374 CCU), and Ocean / pirates is rising at 1.39, up 0.27 (Criminal Simulator 17,329).
ideas.differentiator: Throw-for-X games launch at animals; here you capture whole ships and they fight back.

ideas.title: Joust for Crowns 👑
ideas.hook: Ride a wobbly horse down a castle bridge and knock rival knights into the moat with a ragdoll lance hit. Last rider standing wins the crown.
core_loop: Pick a lance and horse
Charge and aim your hit
Ragdoll rivals into the moat
Win rounds to earn crowns
Spend crowns on lances and armour
ideas.twist: Whoever wears the crown glows and every other player gets bonus crowns for knocking them off.
ideas.why_now: Fight / battle + Hit / swing is a live pair (13 new games, 83,563 CCU) with Realistic Ragdoll MMA (12,309) and Half Punch (14,750). Fantasy / medieval is rising at 1.50, up 0.51 this week (Kit PVP FFA 9,207), voxel art is the top rising art style at 2.38, and arena maps are at 1.38.
ideas.differentiator: Ragdoll fighting games are bare fists in a ring; this adds mounted charges and a king-of-the-hill crown.

ideas.title: Build a Wrecking Crane 🏗️
ideas.hook: Build your own crane, hang a wrecking ball on it and smash whole towers into physics rubble for cash.
core_loop: Build and upgrade your crane
Swing the wrecking ball into a tower
Every broken block pays cash
Unlock bigger, tougher buildings
Buy heavier balls and longer arms
ideas.twist: Buildings collapse with real physics, so a well-aimed hit at the base brings the whole tower down for a combo bonus.
monetization: Luck pass for loot crates in rubble
ideas.why_now: Physics Sim is the top rising subgenre at 2.70 (Hyper Realistic Ragdoll 53,925, Dummy Lab 7,778) and Sandbox is at 1.96 (Build Your World! 19,301). Hit / swing (1.96) and Break / mine (1.54) pair up in 10 new games with 72,643 CCU, and 'Build a ___' titles are at 1.43, up 0.26.
ideas.differentiator: Break games use tools in your hands; here you build the machine first, then wreck with it.

ideas.title: Loot the Cursed Keep 🏰
ideas.hook: Squads of four sneak into a cursed castle at night, fight what lives inside and carry treasure out before sunrise.
core_loop: Enter the keep with your squad
Fight monsters room by room
Grab treasure and carry it out
Survive until dawn or escape early
Sell loot for better weapons and armour
ideas.twist: Heavier loot slows you down and makes noise, so greedy players pull the monsters onto the whole team.
ideas.why_now: Fight / battle + Survive is a live pair (13 new games, 75,754 CCU) led by NIGHT WITH OPAH (23,636) and GloryBound (16,576). Fantasy / medieval is rising at 1.50, up 0.51 this week, interior maps are at 1.86 and dark/gritty art is at 1.31.
ideas.differentiator: Horror survival games are about hiding; here you fight back and your greed is what puts the team at risk.

ideas.title: Fish for Survivors 🛶
ideas.hook: The city is flooded and full of zombies. From your rooftop raft, cast lines into the streets to pull up survivors, supplies and the occasional zombie.
core_loop: Cast into flooded streets
Reel up survivors, food or zombies
Fight off zombies you hook by mistake
Survivors join your rooftop base and work for you
Upgrade your raft to reach new districts
ideas.twist: Some catches look like survivors until they are halfway up the line.
ideas.why_now: Fishing is rising at 1.22, up 0.45 this week (Fish For Sea Animals 16,121, Net a Fish! 14,048), and Fishing + Zombies is a gap in the data (score 2.43). Collect / index + Fishing is the busiest live pair (17 new games, 63,844 CCU), and Survive is at 1.05, up 0.26 this week.
ideas.differentiator: Fishing games are calm collection loops; here every cast might bring up a threat as well as a reward.
